# Updated At

## Summary
When the record last meaningfully changed. Monotonic by convention: whatever writes the record moves it forward on each meaningful edit, and decides what counts as meaningful (an index-driven touch usually should not). The atom leads with recency ("2d ago") because "how fresh is this?" is the question dense rows answer; embedded pairs the absolute stamp with the relative form. Unset renders an em-dash — a record never updated since creation shows Created At alone.

## Usage
```ts
import UpdatedAtField from '@cardstack/catalog/fields/updated-at/updated-at-field';

@field updatedAt = contains(UpdatedAtField);
```
Serializes exactly like `DateTimeField`, so an existing `updatedAt: DateTimeField` upgrades in place. A primitive field cannot carry inline examples, so this Spec shows a live value in full and as an atom, and the linked Activity Log example shows it beside Created At.

## Non-goals
The block does not write itself — auto-touch on save is a command/host concern. It is not an audit trail: one timestamp, not a history (an Audit Timeline is its own concept). Creation time is the sibling Created At block.
